Class VectorIndexHelper

java.lang.Object
com.cockroachlabs.data.ddl.VectorIndexHelper
public final class VectorIndexHelper extends Object
Generates CockroachDB v26.2+ CREATE VECTOR INDEX DDL.

In CockroachDB v26.2, the legacy CREATE INDEX ... USING cspann syntax is replaced by the dedicated CREATE VECTOR INDEX statement, which supports prefix columns for pre-filtered vector searches.

Migration from v24.x / v25.x:

-- Old (v24.x/v25.x):
CREATE INDEX idx ON docs USING cspann (embedding vector_cosine_ops);

-- New (v26.2+):
CREATE VECTOR INDEX idx ON docs (embedding vector_cosine_ops);

-- With prefix columns (v26.2+):
CREATE VECTOR INDEX idx ON docs (tenant_id, embedding vector_cosine_ops);

      public static String generateCreateVectorIndex(String indexName, String tableName, String vectorColumn, DistanceMetric metric, String... prefixColumns)
      Generate a v26.2-compatible CREATE VECTOR INDEX statement.
      Parameters:
      indexName - the index name
      tableName - the table containing the vector column
      vectorColumn - the column holding VECTOR data
      metric - the distance metric (determines the opclass)
      prefixColumns - optional prefix columns for pre-filtering (may be empty)
